messages:
Maya (Head of Strategy): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Drop brief Qs about mission, positioning, roadmap tradeoffs here.
Sam (Sales): Need a one-line for the sales deck that focuses on ops guarantees (not just features).
Asha (CEO): Try: "Redwood delivers predictable inference economics and rollout safety across hosted, reserved, and private deployments."
Nina (Solutions Eng): Customers ask: what operational metrics prove "predictable"?
Marco (CTO): Recommend p50/p95 latency, per-route token cost, cache hit rate, and time-to-rollback. We'll expose these in Console.
Priya (VP Product): Regarding roadmap: leadership wants a rubric for infra features prioritization  what signals should we use?
Asha (CEO): Top signals: recurring customer asks/blockers, measurable unit-cost or latency impact, and risk to safe rollouts.
Sam (Sales): Any public guidance on when to move from Hosted -> Dedicated we can share?
Maya (Head of Strategy): Short rule: consider Dedicated when sustained throughput or latency variance impacts SLAs or when reserved commits yield material savings. We'll publish a checklist.
ops-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/2301112222 :white_check_mark:
Maya (Head of Strategy): I'll collate answers and post a 1-page FAQ + checklist by Friday. Ping me if you need items included.
